config.showWelcomeOnStartup: Controls whether to show the Agent Cowork welcome page on startup.
config.simplifyLayout: Simplifies the user interface by hiding the activity bar icon buttons and keeping the file directory view open.
config.browserTabs: Configures editor tabs to behave like a web browser (tabs shrink to fit window width before scrolling horizontally, no preview replacement mode).
config.hideGitAndDrawers: Hides Git integration and extra drawers (Clone Repository, Outline, Timeline) for non-technical users.
